queries.load_mutations: select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)) from (select regexp_replace(i.idempotency_key,'-[0-9]+$','') run, count(*) committed, count(*) filter(where i.completed and i.response_status=201) completed_201, count(distinct p.id) unique_payments,count(*) filter(where v.source_id is not null and v.amount_minor=p.amount and v.source_version=p.version and v.lifecycle_status=p.status) matching_targets from idempotency_records i left join payment_intents p on p.tenant_id=i.tenant_id and p.id=i.response_body::jsonb->>'id' left join payment_intents_v2 v on v.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and v.source_id=p.id where i.tenant_id='tenant_demo' and (i.idempotency_key like 'cloud-load-%' or i.idempotency_key like 'cloud-live-backfill-%' or i.idempotency_key like 'cloud-healthy-%') group by 1 order by 1) s;
queries.outbox: select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)) from (select tenant_id,count(*) events,count(*) filter(where published_at is null) unpublished from outbox_events group by tenant_id order by tenant_id) s;
queries.fault_settlements: select jsonb_build_object('payments',(select count(*) from payment_intents where tenant_id='tenant_faults'),'succeeded',(select count(*) from payment_intents where tenant_id='tenant_faults' and status='succeeded' and amount_received=1000),'journals',(select count(*) from ledger_transactions where tenant_id='tenant_faults'),'entries',(select count(*) from ledger_entries e join ledger_transactions j on j.id=e.ledger_transaction_id where j.tenant_id='tenant_faults'),'unbalanced',(select count(*) from (select e.ledger_transaction_id from ledger_entries e join ledger_transactions j on j.id=e.ledger_transaction_id where j.tenant_id='tenant_faults' group by e.ledger_transaction_id having sum(e.debit)<>sum(e.credit) or count(*)<>2) s));
